purpose: Warn that the described state would make a good result impossible.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause / Nの / な-adjectiveな + ようでは
If you are late every time, you will lose people’s trust.
If you give up over this much, you will not make it to the end.
If the explanation is this vague, no one can make a judgment.
formation: Plain clause / Nの / な-adjectiveな + ようでは
restrictions: Often followed by a negative consequence or concern about ability.
mistake: This evaluates a problematic state; it is not a neutral comparison.
